name: wat
speaker: Wat
notes: Agnes's grandson, 16. Starts the apprenticeship thread (sets wat_asked); pays it off with a crooked dagger (osric_decided = 1) or sulks (= 2).

nodes.text: Oh! Hello. You're new. You're not from Stowe, are you? Everyone from Stowe is awful.
Wat. Agnes is my gran. I help her with the barrels. Well. I'm near the barrels.

choices.text: What would you rather be doing?

nodes.text: I want to be a smith. Like Osric. Proper work, with fire. He says I'm too soft. Would you... put in a word? He might listen to someone who's been places.
Really? Thanks! Don't tell him I asked. No, do tell him. Tell him I'm keen. I am keen.
I have. Four times. He just hands me a broom.
Have you asked him yet? Go on, he's at the forge. Or the alehouse. He's always one or the other.
He said yes! Dawn tomorrow! I've never seen a dawn on purpose. Here, I made this on the sly at the back of the forge. It's a bit crooked. It's yours.
Gran says you told Osric I was idle. ...I am idle. That's the worst part.
